application_linearization.requirement: Theorem1: increasing committed slots and common deterministic within-slot ordering of lane histories.
application_linearization.artifact_gap: Unused node application upcall traverses proposals HashMap and returns lane ancestors newest-first. Native raw output order differs across replicas.
application_linearization.adapter: Observe complete native slot boundaries; canonical topological zipper (height,author,full header digest) within each completed slot, verify per-lane parent continuity, then wait for locally retained verified native payloads before contiguous output. No sorting acrossslots or protocol voting/commit-set changes.

native_omission_hook.attacker_input: separate declared rate, no honest useful-work credit

shoal.scope: Shoal++ prototype; native shoal_plus_plus has three DAGs and weak votes enabled. Published variant/configuration requires runtime verification; do not substitute Raptr or current Aptos main. Source pin is not build/run acceptance.
shoal.local_fixture: native aptos-genesis builder with explicit DAG genesis; upstream Forge local backend ignores suite genesis callbacks
shoal.acceptance_status: Oct21 observer source reviewed and validator compiled; fixture build and all new live observer gates deferred for Raptr priority; historical Oct19 paired artifact retained
shoal.observer_identity: Native signed Ed25519 workload BCS independently verified by local collector; exact finite native transaction hashes bind useful credit; random per-origin keys; invalid app content preserves native ordinals without useful credit
shoal.acceptance: Native Linux ARM64 validator/fixture build and five local finite-cohort functional accounting gates verified; formal comparison and observer-overhead gates remain open
